note: Canada lane registry. Ids are hand-set <slug>-ca-<prov> (ASCII, lower-case, letters folded by hand, never dropped); permanent once live. Tier: 1 national, 2 provincial/territorial park or reserve, 3 regional. Scripts: scripts/ca_publish.py, scripts/ca_trail_filter.py, scripts/ca-run-area.sh.

areas.name: Prince Edward Island National Park
areas.notes: PEI smoke test 2026-11-01. Local rehearsal 12 trails / 28.7 mi before exclusions; 10 trails after. Dropped as under 0.6 mi (no official-page waiver verified, follow-up): Cavendish Beach Trail 0.32, Dunelands Trail 0.56, Haunted Wood Trail 0.51, Dunes Trail 0.49, Balsam Hollow Trail 0.28, Havre Saint Pierre 0.45, Greenwich Beach 0.28. Long-distance super-relations removed by the engine: Confederation Trail, International Appalachian Trail, Island Trails, Winter River/Breadalbane (Island Walk).
